people.name: Doeg
people.line: Edomite chief shepherd who betrayed David to Saul

people.name: Edom
people.line: Descendants of Esau; enemy nation southeast of Israel

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: Now a certain man of the servants of Saul was there that day, detained before Yahweh; and his name was Doeg the Edomite, the best of the herdsmen who belonged to Saul.
translations.bsb: Now one of Saul’s servants was there that day, detained before the LORD. And his name was Doeg the Edomite, the chief shepherd for Saul.
translations.kjv: Now a certain man of the servants of Saul was there that day, detained before the LORD; and his name was Doeg, an Edomite, the chiefest of the herdmen that belonged to Saul.
translations.asv: Now a certain man of the servants of Saul was there that day, detained before Jehovah; and his name was Doeg the Edomite, the chiefest of the herdsmen that belonged to Saul.
